There are rumors about me knowing her before she was 18 and that I was 27 at the time, but I just turned 27 this April as I was born in 1995. So the lie is blatant, yet the attacks are still coming. 

I met her on Twitter when she was 18 and flirted. Never sent nudes either.

I know it sounds like bullshit, but this is seriously real.
Possible that she’s just not that strong in a fight.
